motion.name: rain-depth
motion.purpose: Wind-driven rain with bounded particle storage.

motion.name: cloud-discharge
motion.purpose: Irregular hierarchical intra-cloud lightning with measured illumination and masked reflection.

motion.name: strike-interval
motion.purpose: Occasional flashes rather than a repeating visual beat.

motion.name: lifecycle
motion.value: Host pause/resume, visibility, FPS profiles; speed 0 freezes simulation
motion.purpose: Respect host resource controls and explicit stillness.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Initially paused; lightning always suppressed; FPS capped at 15
motion.purpose: Preserve reduced-motion behavior after explicit resume.

narrative.overview: A fixed, original alpine lake photograph under heavy charcoal-blue clouds gains depth through layered rain, thin moving haze, lake ripples and occasional procedural lightning. Illumination is restrained and the landscape remains readable.

rules.name: Fixed photograph
rules.body: Animate weather while preserving the original landscape and sky/lake coordinate masks.

dos: Keep rain, wind, lightning, interval, brightness, haze and water adjustable through the host.
Respect pause, visibility, speed zero and reduced motion.
donts: Do not bake foreground rain or lightning into the source photograph.
Do not add HUD, audio, external dependencies or unbounded particle storage.
